identificationModule.briefTitle: Donafenib Monotherapy for Previously Treated Metastatic Gastric Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1B Study of Donafenib Monotherapy for Previously Treated Metastatic Gastric Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This open-label, one-center, noncomparative, two-stage phase 1B trial assessed the donafenib in advanced gastric cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This open-label, one-center, noncomparative, two-stage phase 1B trial assessed the tyrosine kinase inhibitor donafenib tosilate tablets (400 mg/d,200mg bid) in patients with advanced, inoperable gastric cancer progressing after chemotherapy . The primary endpoint is the safety.The secondary endpoints are tumor response and progression-free survival time.
